words.meaning: Hard work, or the effort and earnings a person puts into something.
To bend or lean toward something. To incline your ear means to lean in and pay close attention.
Lasting forever; never coming to an end.
A solemn, binding agreement between two sides. In the Bible, it is often a promise God makes and commits Himself to keep with His people.
God's faithful, loyal love: kindness that sticks with the people He has promised Himself to and does not give up on them.
Someone who tells others what is true from what they have seen or know. Here, David shows the nations who God is.
Evil; deliberately doing what is wrong and against God's ways.
To leave something behind for good and turn away from it.
Not right with God; living in a way that is unjust or sinful.
To forgive someone and let them go free from the punishment their wrong deserves.
To plant seed by scattering it on the ground so it can grow into a crop.
To succeed and turn out well; to get done what it was meant to do.
Guided out and onward, the way a leader walks people out of one place toward another.
A shrub covered in sharp thorns that grows on poor, neglected ground and makes land hard to use.
A prickly, thorny plant or bramble, often a sign of wild, unworked land.
A tall evergreen tree. The Hebrew word may also mean a pine, juniper, or fir.
An evergreen shrub with shiny leaves, sweet-smelling white flowers, and berries, common in the land of Israel.
